message:
I remember the last time we had a blackout — it was a chilly evening, and I was just settling in for a cozy night with a book. When the lights went out, I could’ve panicked about dinner or my phone dying, but instead, I decided to turn it into a little adventure. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some snacks, and we made a little fort in the living room with blankets and pillows. We ended up playing games and sharing stories by lantern light, which turned a potentially frustrating situation into a fun, memorable night. 

It’s amazing how a little creativity can shift our perspective! Have you ever turned a blackout into a cozy event? I’d love to hear your tips!
